response.answer: English and mathematics teachers in Saudi Arabia face challenges integrating 21st century skills due to limited resources and traditional teaching methods. Barriers include lack of training and insufficient technology support. Some initiatives aim to address these issues.

results.content: **Regional Conference on Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) in Latin America and the Caribbean** This event will bring together leaders in technical education, TVET providers from the region, private sector companies, international organizations and academics from the region, with the aim of generating synergies and promoting the development of labour skills aligned with the challenges of the 21st century. **Conference on Technical and Vocational Education & Training: Challenges and Opportunities** PAAET (Kuwait UNEVOC Centre) is organizing a TVET conference with the aim to provide an opportunity for experts in TVET to share experiences and establish collaborations at National, Regional and International levels; discuss strategies for the development of TVET towards manpower social, and economic variations; identify the international experiences in development of TVET; and identify the latest methods of quality assurance in TVET. **Singapore International Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Conference 2012** Excellent opportunity for participants to learn practical strategies from the Singapore experience.
